name: building-blocks trigger queries
description: Should trigger when implementing block or core code with the content model already decided; near misses overlap the CDD set.

queries.query: Authors will write a new tabs block as a table: a tab label column and a content column, one row per tab. Write the decorate function and CSS for that block so it works with exactly that markup.

```html
<script src="https://widget.example-chat.com/loader.js" data-site="acme-123" async></script>
```

I need to add a global click handler for outbound links in scripts.js that adds target=_blank. Where should that live so it runs on every page without affecting performance?
The hero block uses a plain img with a huge source. Switch it to use createOptimizedPicture with sensible breakpoints and keep eager loading for the first image.
Add support for `columns (reverse)` to the columns block using a CSS-only variant. Don't change the authoring structure.
Change how the footer block pulls in its fragment so it still works when the footer.plain.html is missing. I have the current footer.js open.

Please review PR #214 on our EDS repo. Someone added a tabs block and I want to make sure it follows our conventions before I merge. Just leave comments, don't push changes.
